quotes.title: WASP-60
quotes.card: WASP-60, also named Morava, is a F-type main-sequence star about 1,400 light-years away in the constellation Pegasus.
quotes.introduction: The star's age is much younger than the Sun's at 1.7±0.5 billion years.
